proposal.hypothesis: The selected parent uses an 8192-element target and caps the grid at 2048 partials (0.000294683 s). Raising only the cap to 4096 keeps the partial count unchanged for the 1,048,576-element case but doubles the count and finalizer fan-in at the largest size. This tests whether that additional large-input parallelism outweighs the extra partial writes and finalization work; no speedup is assumed.
